title: GreenGateway Connection OpenAPI Overlay
description: Version 0.1 declarative overlay applied when a Connection's OpenAPI catalog is generated. It narrows and reshapes generated tools; it cannot add upstream paths, methods, or credentials. Tool references use generated (operationId) names. This revision accepts rename, description, visibility, parameter title/description, defaults.body_mode and defaults.disambiguation; the enum_sources, label_sources, shapes, response and composites branches are reserved and rejected until their implementation lands.

body_mode.description: Body serialisation for every tool named under tools.* (and only those). body_args_json omits path and query arguments from the JSON body; whole_args_json is today's behaviour and stays in force for tools not named under tools.*.

response_root.description: Reserved for declarative transforms: selector over the parsed response body that yields the object(s) carrying wire shapes. Not accepted by this revision.

enum_sources.description: Reserved for dynamic enum binding. Not accepted by this revision.

label_sources.description: Reserved for label sources. Not accepted by this revision.

shapes.description: Reserved for declarative transforms. Not accepted by this revision.

tools.description: Per-tool overlays keyed by the GENERATED tool name (the document's operationId, as the OpenAPI preview shows it), never by a rename target. Only tools named here are overlaid; every other generated tool keeps its generated definition byte-for-byte.

composites.description: Reserved for composite tools with compensation. Not accepted by this revision.

json_pointer.description: RFC 6901 pointer. Its base depends on the field: see the pointer-base table in the operator guide (wire pointers: the parameter's wire value; response bindings: the parameter's wire value inside a selected root object; $step/$self: the whole parsed body of that step; $input/$item: that value).

selector.description: Bounded path over JSON, evaluated from the parsed body. Segments: an object key; a key followed by [field=literal], which keeps the elements of an array of objects whose `field` is a JSON string exactly equal to `literal` (use int:5 or bool:true to compare against a JSON integer or boolean; a number or boolean never matches a bare literal); or * for every element of an array or every value of an object, in document order. No recursion, no expressions, depth <= 32. A segment applied to a value of the wrong kind selects nothing.

label_from.description:
Where the human label of a property comes from, in priority order. label_source is the tool's labels_from source (reserved in this revision and therefore never contributes); title and description are the document's own keywords. Upstreams that emit neither (Twenty emits description only when a user typed one) need hand-written parameters.

.description.

template.description: Placeholders: {label}, {name}, {options}. {name} is mandatory, because a template without it cannot tell two properties apart. {options} renders as '; options: A, B, C' from a static document enum (<= 16 shown, then …), as '; options: see the enum in this schema' for a property bound to an enum_source, and as '' otherwise.

rename.description: The name served by tools/list, the inventory, audit, and the policy file. Overlay-internal references keep using the generated name. A rename target may not be a generated name of this catalog, another rename target, a tool in another registry lane, or a name the live policy file already grants (unless the stored overlay revision being replaced already owned it).

visibility.description: composite_only: not listed by tools/list, not callable by tools/call directly (unknown tool), only invocable as a composite step or compensation; still shown in the admin inventory and usable from the admin playground.

labels_from.description: Reserved for label sources. Not accepted by this revision.

parameters.description: Keyed by a top-level property name of the tool's generated input schema.

response.description: Reserved for declarative transforms. Not accepted by this revision.

description.description: Replaces the property's description. Always wins over disambiguation.

enum_source.description: Reserved for dynamic enum binding. Not accepted by this revision.

shape.description: Reserved for declarative transforms. Not accepted by this revision.

enum_sources.description: Reserved: dynamic enum sources (GET request + selector + cache policy + limits). Lands with the dynamic enum binding PR.

enum_source_reference.description: Reserved: a parameter's reference to an enum_sources entry.

label_sources.description: Reserved: label sources (GET request + selector) resolved at compile time.

label_source_reference.description: Reserved: a tool's labels_from reference to a label_sources entry.

source_request.description: Reserved: the GET request of an enum or label source.

source_limits.description: Reserved: item, byte and response limits of a source.

shape_or_use.description: Reserved: an inline shape or a $use reference.

agent_fragment.description: Reserved: a JSON Schema fragment for one agent-facing property.

wire_binding.description: Reserved: how one wire pointer is written.

response_binding.description: Reserved: how one agent property is rebuilt from a response.

codec_chain.description: Reserved: one codec or an ordered list of codecs.

response_overlay.description: Reserved: response root and decode-only fields.

binding.description: Reserved: a literal or a $input/$step/$item/$self reference.
